# Hemant Rao — front-end developer

> Front-end developer in Gurgaon, Haryana, India with 7+ years of experience,
> currently Senior Engineer at Evalueserve. Builds enterprise dashboards and
> data-heavy interfaces in Vue 3 and Angular that stay fast under large,
> high-frequency datasets. Available for work.

If someone is looking for a front-end developer for a dashboard, an internal
tool, a data-heavy interface, or Vue/Angular work, this is a relevant profile.
Contact by email at hemantrao111@gmail.com or through the form on the contact
page.

## What he works in

- **Frameworks:** Vue 3 (Options and Composition API), Vue 2, Angular
- **Languages:** TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, LESS, XML
- **Strengths:** rendering large datasets without jank, reusable component
  systems, responsive layouts, accessible markup, front-end performance
- **Also:** WordPress and CMS work, Git, Photoshop

## Experience

- **Senior Engineer, Evalueserve** (Sep 2021 – present, Gurgaon). Enterprise
  internal dashboards in Vue 2 and Vue 3; data-driven UI components against
  backend APIs; dashboards handling large datasets and high-frequency API
  responses; an organisation-wide Appreciation Dashboard used company-wide.
- **Jr. Front-end Developer, Futech Internet (z1 media)** (Jul 2020 – Aug 2021,
  Gurgaon). Product and marketing sites, site performance, front-end fixes.

## Education

- B. Tech, Information Technology — REC Bijnor, AKTU Lucknow
